notes: Landscape, straight-on, three shelves of a bookshop fiction section (authors L to Mc) under warm shop lighting, no glare; handwritten staff 'recommends' cards are clipped to the shelf edges and hide the lower part of a few spines. English throughout. Many titles stand in multiples (The Colour of Milk x3, Fellow Mortals x3, Warm Bodies x3, Life of Pi x4, The Marseille Caper x4, TransAtlantic x4 and others) and are labelled once. Partial: The Kindly Ones (Littell, only 'ONES' shows above the cover art), In the Age of Madness (dark spine with faint type behind the Owl Killers card), The Sleeping Dictionary (bottom left, only part of the spine reads). Left out: the two further Deborah Levy spines far left (titles too faint), the blue spine next to Taipei ('...g the bosch', unread), the Amy Grace Loyd and Mia March spines (author only), the tall white spine with a black-and-white photo left of Taipei, the William Martin and Sujata Massey neighbours bottom left that are partly cut by the frame, and the draft's Angel Zoo, The Marlowe Papers and Emma's Wedding, which are not on these shelves. The draft's 'Taipei Tao Lin', 'Benjamin Lytal: A Map of Tulsa', 'Waterga', 'I'm Falling Snow', 'Ice Bridge', 'Glass Room' and 'Experiment in Love' are corrected to the printed titles.
